<section class="research-section" aria-labelledby="research-interests">
<h2 id="research-interests">Research Interests</h2>
<p>I develop statistical methods for complex outcomes, with applications in health research.</p>
<ul class="research-themes"><li>Survival analysis</li><li>Causal inference</li><li>Clinical trials</li><li>Semiparametric theory</li><li>Statistical learning</li></ul>
<p class="research-applications">Applications in diagnostic medicine, oncology, cardiology, and behavioral health.</p>
